q: 南郑中心污水处理厂的设计处理规模是多少？
sql: SELECT name AS 厂站, capacity_m3d AS 设计处理规模_m3_d FROM plant WHERE name LIKE '%南郑中心%' LIMIT 200

q: 采用氧化沟工艺的有哪几个厂站？
sql: SELECT name AS 厂站, kind AS 类型, capacity_m3d AS 设计规模_m3_d FROM plant WHERE process = '氧化沟' ORDER BY id LIMIT 200

q: 集镇厂里设计规模最大的是哪一个？
sql: SELECT name AS 厂站, process AS 工艺, capacity_m3d AS 设计规模_m3_d FROM plant WHERE kind = '集镇厂' ORDER BY capacity_m3d DESC LIMIT 1

q: 全区一共有多少台鼓风机，其中有几台是备用的？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 鼓风机总数, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status = '备用') AS 备用台数 FROM device WHERE kind = '鼓风机' LIMIT 200

q: 按设备类型统计全区设备的数量和总额定功率

q: 梁山镇污水处理站有哪些设备？列出编码和类型
sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, d.kind AS 设备类型, d.model AS 型号, d.rated_kw AS 额定功率_kW, d.status AS 状态 FROM device AS d JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%梁山%' ORDER BY d.code LIMIT 100

q: 全区所有厂站的设计规模加起来是多少？
sql: SELECT SUM(capacity_m3d) AS 设计规模合计_m3_d, COUNT(*) AS 厂站数 FROM plant LIMIT 200

q: 中心厂现在的进水流量是多少？
sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, r.ts AS 时间, ROUND(CAST(r.inflow_m3h AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 进水流量_m3h FROM plant_reading AS r JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND r.ts > CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '30 MINUTES' ORDER BY r.ts DESC LIMIT 1

q: 当前各厂好氧区溶解氧分别是多少？
sql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.id) p.name AS 厂站, r.ts AS 时间, ROUND(CAST(r.do_aerobic_1 AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 好氧区1号DO, ROUND(CAST(r.do_aerobic_2 AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 好氧区2号DO FROM plant_reading AS r JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.ts > CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '30 MINUTES' ORDER BY p.id, r.ts DESC LIMIT 200

q: 协税镇现在的污泥浓度MLSS是多少？
sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, r.ts AS 时间, ROUND(CAST(r.mlss AS DECIMAL), 0) AS 污泥浓度MLSS FROM plant_reading AS r JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' AND r.ts > CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '2 HOURS' ORDER BY r.ts DESC LIMIT 1

q: 中心厂1号鼓风机现在的电流是多少？
sql: SELECT d.code AS 设备编码, r.ts AS 时间, ROUND(CAST(r.current_a AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 电流_A, r.running AS 是否运行 FROM device_reading AS r JOIN device AS d ON d.id = r.device_id WHERE d.code = 'P01-BL-1' AND r.ts > CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '30 MINUTES' ORDER BY r.ts DESC LIMIT 1

q: 现在哪个厂的出水总氮最高？
sql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.id) p.name AS 厂站, r.ts AS 时间, ROUND(CAST(r.tn_out AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 出水总氮_mgL FROM plant_reading AS r JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.ts > CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '30 MINUTES' AND r.tn_out IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p.id, r.ts DESC LIMIT 1

q: 昨天全区一共处理了多少水？
sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(h.inflow_m3h) AS DECIMAL)) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h AS h WHERE h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND h.hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) LIMIT 200

q: 中心厂昨天鼓风机一共耗电多少度？
sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, ROUND(CAST(SUM(h.blower_kw) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 鼓风机耗电量_kWh FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND h.hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) GROUP BY p.name LIMIT 200

q: 本周到目前为止各厂分别处理了多少水？
sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, ROUND(CAST(COALESCE(SUM(h.inflow_m3h), 0) AS DECIMAL), 0) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant AS p LEFT JOIN plant_reading_1h AS h ON h.plant_id = p.id AND h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 200

q: 10月30日到11月4日这6天，梁山镇平均每天处理多少水？
sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST((SUM(h.inflow_m3h) / 6) AS DECIMAL), 0) AS 平均日处理水量_m3, ROUND(CAST(SUM(h.inflow_m3h) AS DECIMAL), 0) AS 期间总处理水量_m3, COUNT(DISTINCT DATE_TRUNC('DAY', h.hour)) AS 天数 FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%梁山%' AND h.hour >= CAST('2026-10-30 00:00:00+08' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND h.hour < CAST('2026-11-05 00:00:00+08' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) LIMIT 200

q: 昨天中心厂出水COD、氨氮、总氮、总磷的日均值
sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, ROUND(CAST(AVG(h.cod_out) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 出水COD日均值, ROUND(CAST(AVG(h.nh3n_out) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 出水氨氮日均值, ROUND(CAST(AVG(h.tn_out) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 出水总氮日均值, ROUND(CAST(AVG(h.tp_out) AS DECIMAL), 3) AS 出水总磷日均值 FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.kind = '中心厂' AND h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND h.hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) GROUP BY p.id, p.name LIMIT 200

q: 今天上午中心厂进水COD的平均值是多少？
sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, ROUND(CAST(AVG(h.cod_in) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 进水COD平均值_mgL FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) + INTERVAL '6 HOURS' AND h.hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) + INTERVAL '12 HOURS' GROUP BY p.id, p.name LIMIT 200

q: 过去24小时各厂的平均进水氨氮
sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, ROUND(CAST(AVG(h.nh3n_in) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 平均进水氨氮_mgL, COUNT(*) AS 小时数 FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '24 HOURS' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id LIMIT 200

q: 昨天全区鼓风机总耗电量和吨水曝气电耗是多少？
sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(h.blower_kw) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 鼓风机总耗电量_kWh, ROUND(CAST((SUM(h.blower_kw) / NULLIF(SUM(h.inflow_m3h), 0)) AS DECIMAL), 4) AS 吨水曝气电耗_kWh FROM plant_reading_1h AS h WHERE h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND h.hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) LIMIT 200

q: 本周全区碳源和PAC分别一共投加了多少公斤？
sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(h.carbon_dose_kgh) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 碳源投加量_kg, ROUND(CAST(SUM(h.pac_dose_kgh) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS PAC投加量_kg FROM plant_reading_1h AS h WHERE h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) LIMIT 200

q: 昨天的最高气温和最低气温分别是多少？
sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(MAX(temp_c) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 最高气温, ROUND(CAST(MIN(temp_c) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 最低气温 FROM weather WHERE ts >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND ts < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) LIMIT 200

q: 过去7天各厂的平均污泥浓度
sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, ROUND(CAST(AVG(r.mlss) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 平均污泥浓度_mgL, COUNT(*) AS 样本数 FROM plant_reading AS r JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.ts >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' AND r.mlss IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id LIMIT 200

q: 昨天中心厂好氧区平均曝气风量是多少？
sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, ROUND(CAST(AVG(h.air_flow_m3h) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 平均曝气风量_m3h FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND h.hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) GROUP BY p.name LIMIT 200

q: 11月3日协税镇每小时的出水总磷均值
sql: SELECT h.hour AS 时间, ROUND(CAST(AVG(h.tp_out) AS DECIMAL), 3) AS 出水总磷均值 FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' AND h.hour >= CAST('2026-11-03 00:00:00+08' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND h.hour < CAST('2026-11-04 00:00:00+08' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) GROUP BY h.hour ORDER BY h.hour LIMIT 200

q: 今天每小时全区的处理水量
sql: SELECT h.hour AS 时间, ROUND(CAST(SUM(h.inflow_m3h) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h AS h WHERE h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AND h.hour < CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) GROUP BY h.hour ORDER BY h.hour LIMIT 200

q: 本周每天中心厂的吨水曝气电耗
sql: SELECT CAST(TIME_BUCKET('1 day', h.hour, 'Asia/Shanghai') AS DATE) AS 日期, ROUND(CAST(SUM(h.inflow_m3h) AS DECIMAL), 0) AS 处理水量_m3, ROUND(CAST(SUM(h.blower_kw) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 鼓风机耗电量_kWh, ROUND(CAST((SUM(h.blower_kw) / NULLIF(SUM(h.inflow_m3h), 0)) AS DECIMAL), 4) AS 吨水曝气电耗_kWh FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.code = 'P01' AND h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AND h.hour < CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 200

q: 11月1日到11月4日每天的平均气温
sql: SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('DAY', ts) AS DATE) AS 日期, ROUND(CAST(AVG(temp_c) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 平均气温_℃ FROM weather WHERE ts >= DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AND ts < DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) + INTERVAL '4 DAYS' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 200

q: 过去7天哪个厂的平均出水COD最高？
sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, ROUND(CAST(AVG(h.cod_out) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 平均出水COD_mgL FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

q: 昨天处理水量排名前三的厂站
sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, ROUND(CAST(SUM(h.inflow_m3h) AS DECIMAL)) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND h.hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 3

q: 过去7天各厂吨水碳源投加量（kg/m³）从高到低排列
sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, ROUND(CAST((SUM(h.carbon_dose_kgh) / NULLIF(SUM(h.inflow_m3h), 0)) AS DECIMAL), 6) AS 吨水碳源投加量_kg_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 200

q: 过去7天出水COD最高的那个小时是哪个厂、什么时间、多少？
sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, h.hour AS 时间, ROUND(CAST(h.cod_out AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 出水COD_mgL FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' AND h.cod_out IS NOT NULL ORDER BY h.cod_out DESC LIMIT 1

q: 过去7天哪一天全区处理水量最大？
sql: SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('DAY', h.hour) AS DATE) AS 日期, ROUND(CAST(SUM(h.inflow_m3h) AS DECIMAL)) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h AS h WHERE h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' AND h.hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

q: 本周吨水曝气电耗最低的两个厂
sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, ROUND(CAST((SUM(h.blower_kw) / SUM(h.inflow_m3h)) AS DECIMAL), 4) AS 吨水曝气电耗_kWh, ROUND(CAST(SUM(h.inflow_m3h) AS DECIMAL), 0) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 2

q: 过去7天有哪些厂出现过出水氨氮超标？
sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, COUNT(*) AS 超标小时数, ROUND(CAST(MAX(h.nh3n_out_max) AS DECIMAL), 3) AS 最高氨氮, ROUND(CAST(AVG(h.nh3n_out_max) AS DECIMAL), 3) AS 平均氨氮 FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' AND h.nh3n_out_max > 5 GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id LIMIT 200

q: 11月4日黄官镇氨氮超标了几个小时？最高到了多少？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE h.nh3n_out_max > 5) AS 氨氮超标小时数, ROUND(CAST(MAX(h.nh3n_out_max) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 氨氮小时最高值_mgL FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官%' AND h.hour >= CAST('2026-11-04 00:00:00+08' AS TIMESTAMP) AND h.hour < CAST('2026-11-05 00:00:00+08' AS TIMESTAMP) LIMIT 200

q: 本周全区出水总磷超标的小时数一共有多少？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 总磷超标小时数, COUNT(DISTINCT h.plant_id) AS 涉及厂站数, ROUND(CAST(MAX(h.tp_out_max) AS DECIMAL), 3) AS 最高总磷 FROM plant_reading_1h AS h WHERE h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AND h.tp_out_max > 0.5 LIMIT 200

q: 昨天每个厂各有几个小时出水不达标？没有超标的厂也要列出来
sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, COUNT(h.hour) FILTER(WHERE h.cod_out > 50 OR h.nh3n_out_max > 5 OR h.tn_out > 15 OR h.tp_out_max > 0.5 OR h.ss_out > 10) AS 不达标小时数 FROM plant AS p LEFT JOIN plant_reading_1h AS h ON h.plant_id = p.id AND h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND h.hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id LIMIT 200

q: 过去7天中心厂出水总氮的平均值和最大小时均值
sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, ROUND(CAST(AVG(h.tn_out) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 平均出水总氮_mgL, ROUND(CAST(MAX(h.tn_out) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 最大小时均值_mgL, COUNT(*) AS 统计小时数 FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.code = 'P01' AND h.hour >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' GROUP BY p.name LIMIT 200

q: 协税镇本周第一次出现总磷超标是什么时候？
sql: SELECT h.hour AS 时间, p.name AS 厂站, ROUND(CAST(h.tp_out_max AS DECIMAL), 3) AS 出水总磷最大值_mg_L FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' AND h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AND h.hour < DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) + INTERVAL '7 DAYS' AND h.tp_out_max > 0.5 ORDER BY h.hour ASC LIMIT 1

q: 过去7天振动值最大的鼓风机是哪台？最大振动是多少？
sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, ROUND(CAST(MAX(r.vibration_mms) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 最大振动_mm_s, TO_CHAR((ARRAY_AGG(r.ts ORDER BY r.vibration_mms DESC))[1], 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS 出现时间 FROM device_reading AS r JOIN device AS d ON d.id = r.device_id JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE d.kind = '鼓风机' AND r.ts >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' AND r.vibration_mms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.name, d.code ORDER BY MAX(r.vibration_mms) DESC LIMIT 1

q: 11月4日黄官镇1号鼓风机停机了多少分钟？（设备数据每分钟一条）

q: 过去7天降雨强度最大的那一天，全区处理了多少水？
sql: WITH rain_days AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('DAY', ts) AS day, MAX(rain_mm_h) AS max_rain FROM weather WHERE ts >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' AND ts < CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) GROUP BY 1), top_day AS (SELECT day, max_rain FROM rain_days ORDER BY max_rain DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) SELECT TO_CHAR(top_day.day, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "日期", ROUND(CAST(top_day.max_rain AS DECIMAL), 2) AS "最大降雨强度(mm/h)", ROUND(CAST(SUM(pr.inflow_m3h) AS DECIMAL), 0) AS "全区处理水量(m³)" FROM top_day JOIN plant_reading_1h AS pr ON pr.hour >= top_day.day AND pr.hour < top_day.day + INTERVAL '1 DAY' GROUP BY top_day.day, top_day.max_rain LIMIT 200

q: 11月3日协税镇出水总磷最高达到多少？
sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, ROUND(CAST(MAX(r.tp_out_max) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 出水总磷最高值_mgL FROM plant_reading_1h AS r JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' AND r.hour >= '2026-11-03 00:00:00+08' AND r.hour < '2026-11-04 00:00:00+08' GROUP BY p.name LIMIT 200

q: 昨天全区的处理水量比前天多了多少立方米？
sql: WITH d AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) THEN inflow_m3h END), 0) AS yesterday_water, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '2 DAYS' AND hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' THEN inflow_m3h END), 0) AS before_yesterday_water FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '2 DAYS' AND hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ))) SELECT ROUND(CAST(yesterday_water AS DECIMAL), 2) AS "昨日处理水量_m3", ROUND(CAST(before_yesterday_water AS DECIMAL), 2) AS "前日处理水量_m3", ROUND(CAST((yesterday_water - before_yesterday_water) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS "比前天增加_m3" FROM d LIMIT 200

q: 过去7天平均进水COD高于全区平均水平的厂站有哪些？
sql: WITH p AS (SELECT plant_id, AVG(cod_in) AS avg_cod FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' GROUP BY plant_id), r AS (SELECT AVG(cod_in) AS region_avg FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS') SELECT pl.name AS 厂站名称, ROUND(CAST(p.avg_cod AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 近7天平均进水COD, ROUND(CAST(r.region_avg AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 全区平均进水COD, ROUND(CAST((p.avg_cod - r.region_avg) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 高出全区均值 FROM p JOIN plant AS pl ON pl.id = p.plant_id CROSS JOIN r WHERE p.avg_cod > r.region_avg ORDER BY p.avg_cod DESC LIMIT 200

q: 过去7天中心厂处理水量占全区的百分比
sql: WITH t AS (SELECT p.kind, SUM(r.inflow_m3h) AS vol FROM plant_reading_1h AS r JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' GROUP BY p.kind) SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN kind = '中心厂' THEN vol ELSE 0 END) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 中心厂处理水量, ROUND(CAST(SUM(vol) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 全区处理水量, ROUND(CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN kind = '中心厂' THEN vol ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(vol), 0) * 100) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 占比百分比 FROM t LIMIT 200

q: 过去7天各厂的总氮去除率（百分比）
sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, ROUND(CAST((AVG(r.tn_in) - AVG(r.tn_out)) / NULLIF(AVG(r.tn_in), 0) * 100 AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 总氮去除率百分比, ROUND(CAST(AVG(r.tn_in) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 进水总氮均值, ROUND(CAST(AVG(r.tn_out) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 出水总氮均值, COUNT(*) AS 统计小时数 FROM plant_reading_1h AS r JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' AND r.hour < CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND r.tn_in IS NOT NULL AND r.tn_out IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY 总氮去除率百分比 DESC LIMIT 200

q: 昨天各厂的实际处理水量占设计规模的负荷率（百分比）
sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, p.capacity_m3d AS 设计规模_m3d, ROUND(CAST(SUM(r.inflow_m3h) AS DECIMAL), 0) AS 昨日处理水量_m3, ROUND(CAST((SUM(r.inflow_m3h) / p.capacity_m3d * 100) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 负荷率_百分比 FROM plant AS p LEFT JOIN plant_reading_1h AS r ON r.plant_id = p.id AND r.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND r.hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.capacity_m3d ORDER BY p.id LIMIT 200

q: 昨天A2O工艺和氧化沟工艺的厂站分别处理了多少水？
sql: SELECT p.process AS 处理工艺, ROUND(CAST(SUM(r.inflow_m3h) AS DECIMAL), 0) AS 处理水量立方米, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS 厂站数 FROM plant_reading_1h AS r JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND r.hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) GROUP BY p.process ORDER BY 处理水量立方米 DESC LIMIT 200
